drivers.name: Recent trend
drivers.why: Over the last 30 days the price fell 12.2% once the usual seasonal effect is taken out. The forecast carries that direction forward but lets it fade each day, so about 65% of it is kept over the next 30 days.

drivers.name: Season
drivers.why: In the seasonal pattern (from 9 years of prices) the price is usually 0.6% higher in 30 days' time (Nov) than now (Oct).

drivers.name: Last few days' average
drivers.why: Today's price is below the last 5 days' average, and the forecast counts a one-day dip only half, so it starts 0.4% higher than today.

forecast_reason.range: 80% of past misses fell inside -20.9% to +8.4% at 30 days, so that is the likely range.
forecast_reason.trust: Tested on 244 past dates: off by 10.8% on average at 30 days, vs 8.9% for "price stays the same" - it is NOT better than no-change here, so read it as a range, not a number. Direction right 48% of the time.
forecast_reason.blind: It reads only the price's own trend and season. It can't see US interest-rate moves, war or crisis news, central-bank buying, or an import-duty change in the Budget - news like that can move the price outside the range.

rules.english:
2026-10-26 Platinum - STRONG BUY (score +3 of 5): If buying: Good time to buy - buy in 2-3 parts.  If holding: Hold - prices likely to rise.
Why: Mainly because the price is in the cheap part of the year's range and it fell very fast, and such falls often bounce back. Against it: a stronger rupee makes it cheaper in India.
What would change it: Turns BUY if the price rises to Rs 50,362 (+0.2%). Stays STRONG BUY even if it falls 15%.
How sure: Low. Past BUY days (541 since 2017): higher 30 days later on 70% vs 53% of all days -> edge +17 points.
Price: Rs 50,237 per 10 g (Rs 51,744 with 3% GST); 7 days -6.0%, 30 days -14.3%. 30-day outlook Rs 46,502 (likely Rs 39,761 - Rs 54,434).
Saving for years: BUY STEADILY - Keep buying a small fixed amount regularly (say every month); don't try to time it. No long-run rule points either way today. Not counted (its record disagrees): Long trend (200 days).
rules.telugu:
2026-10-26 ప్లాటినం - బాగా కొనండి (స్కోరు +3 / 5)
ఎందుకు: ముఖ్య కారణం: ధర ఈ ఏడాది పరిధిలో తక్కువ భాగంలో ఉంది మరియు చాలా వేగంగా పడిపోయింది, ఇలాంటప్పుడు తరచుగా మళ్ళీ పెరుగుతుంది. వ్యతిరేకంగా: రూపాయి బలపడటం వల్ల భారత్‌లో ధర తగ్గుతుంది.
ఏది మారిస్తే మారుతుంది: ధర Rs 50,362 (+0.2%) కి పెరిగితే కొనండి. ధర 15% తగ్గినా ఇదే సూచన.
నమ్మకం: తక్కువ. గతంలో BUY రోజుల్లో (541 రోజులు) 30 రోజుల తర్వాత 70% సార్లు ధర పెరిగింది; ఏ రోజైనా 53% (తేడా +17).
ధర: 10 గ్రాములకు Rs 50,237 (GST తో Rs 51,744); 7 రోజుల్లో -6.0%, 30 రోజుల్లో -14.3%. 30 రోజుల అంచనా Rs 46,502 (Rs 39,761 - Rs 54,434).
ఏళ్ల తరబడి దాచుకునేవారికి: క్రమంగా కొనండి - ప్రతి నెలా కొద్ది మొత్తం క్రమంగా కొంటూ ఉండండి; సరైన సమయం కోసం ఎదురుచూడకండి. ఈరోజు దీర్ఘకాల నియమాలేవీ ఏ వైపూ చూపడం లేదు.
